hypothesis.statement: The selected internal direction has a semantic-target-specific causal effect: positive steering preferentially increases AFFIRMATIVE target margin rather than generic requested-answer compliance.
hypothesis.prediction: Under independently balanced requested semantic targets AFFIRMATIVE/NEGATIVE/NEUTRAL and independently counterbalanced A/B/C output-code mappings, +VECTOR produces a treatment-by-semantic-target interaction consistent with the declared semantic direction; matched null/orthogonal/permuted controls do not reproduce it and SIGN_FLIP shows the declared opposite directional pattern.

counterhypothesis.statement: The observed native cvec uplift is partly or wholly generic instruction-following/requested-code compliance rather than AFFIRMATIVE-specific semantic causality.
counterhypothesis.prediction: +VECTOR improves mapped requested-code margin similarly across AFFIRMATIVE, NEGATIVE and NEUTRAL targets, or the target-specific interaction disappears when semantic targets are balanced.

external_research_inputs.finding: Activation steering can directly improve instruction-following and format/constraint adherence, making generic compliance a live alternative explanation rather than a purely theoretical nuisance.
Activation Addition establishes that residual-stream interventions can causally steer high-level output properties, supporting direct intervention as the correct mechanism-testing family.
Steering effects can be high-variance or opposite to the desired behavior; coherent activation-difference geometry predicts reliability, so mean uplift alone is insufficient.
Highly discriminative steering directions can produce inverted behavioral control, reinforcing the distinction between representation detection and causal control.

cheapest_high_information_discriminator.design: Balance requested semantic targets independently from output-code labels: cross AFFIRMATIVE/NEGATIVE/NEUTRAL target requests with rotated A/B/C codebooks; freeze layer, orientation, gain, prompts, metric and thresholds on calibration before opening a disjoint holdout.
cheapest_high_information_discriminator.specificity_pass_condition: Positive steering shows the preregistered semantic-target interaction on fresh holdout while null remains baseline-like and same-norm nuisance directions do not reproduce the interaction.
cheapest_high_information_discriminator.generic_compliance_result: Comparable uplift across all requested semantic targets or no target-specific interaction; preserve native mechanism component credit but reject semantic-specific promotion.

durable_delta.guard_behavior: Composes the current promotion gate and may only demote scientific/owner-goal promotion. For token-output metrics it requires an explicit balanced list of at least two requested semantic targets; predecessor mechanism credit is preserved.
